failed.genericInDoubt: The connection dropped before we learned the outcome. This sale may already be registered.
failed.genericRejected: The provider rejected this sale. Nothing was registered, so it is safe to try again once the cause is fixed.

pending.attempt: Registering attempt {n} with the provider. This continues if you leave the page, and the result will be here when you come back.

rejected.registerAgainHint: Sends a new receipt to the provider as attempt {n}. The refused attempt created nothing, so this cannot produce a second receipt.
